# Introduction to Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd.

Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. is a prominent and innovative chemical enterprise strategically located at No. 136, Qingchun Road, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China. Established as a leading player in the chemical industry, the company has built a strong reputation for its commitment to research, development, and production of high-quality chemical new materials that serve a diverse range of industries and applications worldwide.

Situated in Hangzhou, one of China's most dynamic and economically vibrant cities, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. benefits from an exceptional business environment and access to advanced technological resources. The company specializes in the development and manufacturing of silicone-based materials and other specialty chemicals, delivering innovative solutions that meet the evolving demands of modern industries including textiles, personal care, construction, electronics, and industrial manufacturing.

With a strong emphasis on scientific innovation and technological advancement, the company continuously invests in cutting-edge research and development to enhance product performance and expand its portfolio of specialty chemical materials. Guided by a philosophy of quality excellence, environmental responsibility, and customer satisfaction, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. has successfully established long-standing partnerships with clients across domestic and international markets.

The company remains dedicated to driving sustainable growth while contributing positively to the advancement of China's chemical new materials industry on the global stage.
